_comment: Atlassian Jira / Cloud templates. For Atlassian Cloud, the API token is used with HTTP Basic Auth (email:api_token).

jira_cli_env.name: jira_cli_env
jira_cli_env.description: Inject JIRA_API_TOKEN, JIRA_USER, JIRA_INSTANCE for the jira-cli
jira_cli_env._note: Adjust JIRA_USER and JIRA_INSTANCE to match your Atlassian account and instance.

jira_cli_stdin.name: jira_cli_stdin
jira_cli_stdin.description: Pipe the API token to a jira-cli command that reads from stdin
jira_cli_stdin._note: Use with jira-cli commands that accept the token via stdin.

jira_curl_basic.name: jira_curl_basic
jira_curl_basic.description: Wrap curl with HTTP Basic Auth header (email + API token)
jira_curl_basic._note: Replace [email protected] with the email of the Atlassian account that owns the API token.
